preconditions.expression: 2 <= n <= 5000 and 1 <= s <= n and 1 <= e <= n and s != e
preconditions.description: The number of chairs n is between 2 and 5000, and s and e are distinct chair indices between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: len(x) == n and len(a) == n and len(b) == n and len(c) == n and len(d) == n
preconditions.description: The input lists x, a, b, c, and d each have exactly n elements.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi < x[i+1] <= 10**9 for i in range(n-1))
preconditions.description: The chair coordinates x are strictly increasing and each is between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= 10**9 for i in range(n)) and all(1 <= bi <= 10**9 for i in range(n)) and all(1 <= ci <= 10**9 for i in range(n)) and all(1 <= di <= 10**9 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: All elements in a, b, c, and d are between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the minimum time.

The output is the minimum total time for a Hamiltonian path from chair s to chair e, visiting each chair exactly once, where the time for jumping from chair i to chair j is |xi - xj| + ci + bj if j < i, or |xi - xj| + di + aj if j > i.
